Haven Mutual writes cover for boats, shops, and the ordinary risks of a harbour town.

We have been in Old Town since 2009. The office is on Market Row, above the stationer's. You can knock. Someone will be there.

“They settled a claim I had almost talked myself out of making. I still keep the policy.”
— a shop owner in Eastfield

The face in the photograph is one we use on leaflets. It is a stock portrait. It is not a member of staff.

We write small commercial policies, personal belongings, and a modest marine line for skippers who keep a boat in the harbour.

This is not a national brand. If you want a call-centre quote in two minutes, we will probably disappoint you. If you want someone to read the claim, come to Market Row.

Haven Mutual
9 Market Row, Old Town
Port Calder

Weekdays 9:00–16:30. Closed Saturdays in winter, open Saturday mornings from May to September.

The office is not at 18 Harbor Street. If a letter goes there, it is not ours.
